card.name: Digits inside decimal numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit after the decimal point in a number such as 3.8, 0.17 or 2.969, in tables and results text with doses, rates, percentages or confidence intervals.

modes.label: Decimal digit in tables
modes.description: A digit after the decimal point in rows of dose, rate or concentration values.
modes.example: 7.8 2.3 to 3.9 Twice Daily Full-Term 7.5 to 11.3 3.<<8>> to 5.6 Twice Daily

modes.label: Decimal digit in study statistics
modes.description: A digit after the decimal point in event rates, percentages or confidence intervals.
modes.example: overall malformations (POR 1.2; 95% confidence interval 1.<<1>> to 1.4) with par

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly Chinese words and odd fragments, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks a digit inside a decimal number, such as the 8 in 3.8, in dosing tables and study results.
